verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਰਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਜੀਅਤ ਬਬੂਰ ਦ੍ਰੂਮ ਕੰਚਨ ਸੰਪਟ ਮਧਿ ਕਾਚੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan kee baar jaise dheejeeat baboor dhraoom ka(n)chan sa(n)paT madh kaach geh raakheeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as a plant of acacia is protected with the twigs of sandalwood or a glass crystal is stored in a gold box for safety.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਹੰਸ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੈਠਿ ਬਾਇਸੁ ਗਰਬ ਕਰੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪਤਿ ਭਵਨੁ ਮੈ ਜੰਬੁਕ ਭਲਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise ha(n)s paas baiTh bais garab karai mirag pat bhavan mai ja(n)buk bhalaakheeaai ||

en.bdb: just as a filth-eating crow expresses pride of his beauty and life-style or a jackal expresses his desire to go into the lion's den,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਗਰਧਬ ਗਜ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਉਪਹਾਸ ਕਰੈ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਕੋ ਚੋਰ ਡਾਂਡੇ ਦੂਧ ਮਦ ਮਾਖੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise garadhab gaj prat upahaas karai chakravai ko chor ddaa(n)dde dhoodh madh maakheeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as a donkey makes fun of an elephant and an emperor be punished by a thief; wine expresses its anger on milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਨ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਰੈ ਉਲਟੀਐ ਚਾਲ ਕਲੀਕਾਲ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਾਖੀਐ ॥੫੩੨॥
verses.translit_en: saadhan dhurai kai asaadh aparaadh karai ulaTeeaai chaal kaleekaal bhram bhaakheeaai ||532||

en.bdb: These are all the contrary moves of the dark age (Kalyug). The noble souls are suppressed while the culprits indulge in doing sins. (Vice and sins are rampant while noble souls are hiding themselves in this dark age).  (532)
